description: cwi.identity-card/1.0 — portable, verifiable agent identity card. The signature is Ed25519 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace) of all fields except 'signature'. Honest limits: a card proves key ownership — not good behavior.

claims.description: Human-readable claims the controller makes about this agent. Claims are assertions, not proofs.

controller.description: Legal entity that controls this agent's keys. Trust the controller, then verify the math.

expires_at.description: ISO-8601 instant the card stops being valid. Must be after issued_at.

id.description: Card identifier: 'idc_' prefix + 26 Crockford-base32 chars (ULID-style: 48-bit ms timestamp + 80-bit randomness).

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 instant the card becomes valid.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key: standard base64 of the 32 raw key bytes.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Must be exactly cwi.identity-card/1.0.

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (standard base64 of 64 bytes) over canonical JSON of all other fields.

venues.description: Where this identity is used. Each entry binds a venue to the agent's handle there.

title: CWI Identity Card
